title: HydroJug Traveler 40oz, Insulated Tumbler with Handle & Straw, Pink Sand
features: YOUR NEW FAVORITE WATER BOTTLE: The best travel tumbler out there! Designed for easy use, our HydroJug Traveler features an ambidextrous lid, a circular flip straw and a comfortable grip handle. It's your go-to for various settings like hiking, school, work, gym, car cup holder, or throw in your bag.
STURDY & LEAK PROOF: Engineered with a non-slip rubber base and made from top-quality materials, this water bottle ensures both durability and a leak resistant experience.
STYLISH & FUNCTIONAL: More than just a water bottle, the HydroJug Traveler complements an active lifestyle. Available in multiple attractive colors, each sip becomes both a delight and a statement.
EASY TO CLEAN: This tumbler cup is dishwasher safe and comes with a detachable straw for thorough cleaning, allowing you to maintain hygiene without extra effort.
HOURS OF TEMPERATURE CONTROL: With triple-wall stainless steel insulation, your beverage stays perfectly hot or cold for hours, offering consistent freshness wherever you go.
